newsitem.title: USA: WSFS Financial Corp Q3 net drops.
newsitem.headline: WSFS Financial Corp Q3 net drops.

text.p: (All data above 000s except per share numbers)
NOTE: Q3 Net interest income: $11.3 million vs $9.3 million.
Q3 provision for loans losses: $477,000 vs $47,000.
Nine month net interest income: $34.2 million vs $30.2 million.
Nine month provision for loan losses $1.3 million vs $1.1 million.
1995 Q3 and nine month period includes a gain of $11.8 million, or $0.80 a share, from gain on the sale of deposits.
1996 Q3 includes $3.4 million in tax benefits for net operating losses of Providential Home Income Plan.
Total assets at Sept. 30: $1.3 billion vs $1.2 billion.
Net loans at Sept. 30: $807.0 million vs $778.5 million.
Total deposits at Sept. 30: $736.1 million vs $702.9 million.
